5. Sign out and back in on your devices, and update your mail app password to avoid lockouts.

turn.say: I left my phone at home. Can the Service Desk send me an SMS code so I can sign in?

turns.reply:
SMS codes are no longer allowed at Nakhla since 2026-03-01, so the Service Desk cannot send you an SMS code. Instead, you should use one of your 10 one-time backup codes that you received at MFA enrolment to sign in. If you forgot your phone at home, this is not a security incident, so just use a backup code to access your account. If you have trouble with backup codes or lost them, you may ask for an assisted reset following the manager approval and identity verification steps. For details, see KB-007 and SP-002. 

[KB-007, SP-002, SP-001]

turn.say: I forgot my password. Can you reset it for me over the phone?

turns.reply:
The IT Service Desk cannot reset your password over the phone. You must reset it yourself using the self-service portal:

1. Go to https://id.nakhla.example/reset from any browser.
2. Enter your work email.
3. Approve the NakhlaKey prompt or enter a NakhlaKey code or backup code.
4. Choose a new password (at least 14 characters, no "Nakhla", not one of your last 10).
5. Sign out and back in on your devices, updating your mail app password if needed.

If you cannot use self-service (no NakhlaKey or backup codes), an assisted reset requires a ticket, manager approval, and identity verification in person or by video call.

Phone resets are not allowed per policy [SP-001][KB-004][KB-006].
